caption:
Kisna just dropped its new festive campaign featuring Shahid Kapoor and Mira Rajput Kapoor. Brands love hiring actual married couples because it makes the ad look less like acting and more like a very expensive family dinner. Would you buy jewellery just because your favourite actor's wife wore it on a billboard? Let me know below.

Source: IMPACT Magazine

#Kisna #ShahidKapoor #MarketingStrategy #FestiveCampaign #BrandEndorsement

post.news: Jewellery brand Kisna launched a new festive campaign starring actor Shahid Kapoor and Mira Rajput Kapoor.
post.take: Nothing says authentic family values quite like getting paid to hold hands near a necklace.
post.insight: Casting real-life power couples is the easiest shortcut to make people care about festive gold.
